subject: Re: Renewal - SOC 2 re-attestation, retention split & SLA proposal
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@harborfin.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: james.li@harborfin.com, procurement@harborfin.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence split question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the call earlier. To confirm our renewal timeline: Harbor intends to renew in Q1 2027, but we need clarity on what evidence Redwood will provide for the re-attestation. Our audit team is asking whether you can split the evidence delivery into two buckets: (1) production audit logs (30 days rolling ingestion) and (2) historical retention exports (90/365 day windows) for the expanded seat commitment.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the extraction format for historical logs and estimated export time for a 365-day window? (CSV/JSON; S3 link preferred)
- On the SLA side, Harbor needs a proposed addendum that covers increased throughput to support our projected peak. Can you share a draft SLA with retention carve-outs?

We'd like this in time for our external auditor kickoff on Jan 6. Appreciate any sample manifests or a short plan on how you'd stage uploads.

Best,
Erin

--
Erin Walsh
Security Program Manager
Harbor Financial
Attachment: auditor_scope.pdf (application/pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@harborfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence split question

Erin —

Thanks, this is clear. Quick answers up front:
- Historical exports: we can deliver compressed JSONL or CSV to an S3 bucket you designate. For a full 365-day export for your current footprint we estimate 14–18 hours to stage and validate; incremental deltas (monthly) can be delivered in under 2 hours.
- Production audit logs: we can provide a rolling 30-day ingestion feed via secure S3 with manifest updates hourly.

I'll attach a proposed retention matrix and an SLA draft for throughput carve-outs. High-level plan below:
1) Week 1: scope confirmation and S3 bucket exchange
2) Week 2: dry run export (7-day sample) and validation
3) Week 3: full 365 export and manifest handoff
4) Ongoing: hourly rolling manifests + monthly deltas

Open items: I need to confirm whether Harbor wants logs anonymized/pseudonymized on our side prior to transfer — that will affect timeline slightly.

Sharing attachments now.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: retention_matrix_proposal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); harbor_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (text/csv)

From: James Li <james.li@harborfin.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: erin.walsh@harborfin.com, procurement@harborfin.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence split question

Marcus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple notes from procurement and audit:
- Procurement: please include a proposed amendment for the term extension (12 -> 24 months) with pricing tiers reflecting the seat uplift and the retention export work. We need an estimate of one-time export engineering hours.
- Audit: we prefer exports as compressed JSONL and want a SHA256 checksum on each archive. The auditor will run validations; they also asked that retained logs include context fields (request_id, model_id, tenant_id, timestamp, token_count).

Can you confirm anonymization options? We cannot receive any PII fields even in hashed form without our legal signoff.

James

--
James Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
Harbor Financial

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: James Li <james.li@harborfin.com>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@harborfin.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence split question

James/Erin —

We can accommodate the JSONL + SHA256 checksum requirement. On anonymization: Redwood offers three options for export:
A) Full export with PII fields redacted server-side (recommended for faster turnaround)
B) Export with one-way hashing of PII fields (requires legal approval from Harbor)
C) Export with no PII included (we drop PII-at-source fields before export)

Estimated one-time engineering hours for a 365-day extraction and validation:
- Option A: 40 hours (redaction rules + validation)
- Option B: 60 hours (hashing + legal review + key management)
- Option C: 30 hours (filtering + validation)

On the term amendment: we propose a 24-month renewal with a contingency clause for a 12‑month opt-out if retention exports exceed the estimated export hours by more than 25%.

Next steps: I will share a redline SLA and the proposed one-time engineering estimate in a follow-up this afternoon.

Best,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: redwood_sla_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: ering.walsh@harborfin.com, james.li@harborfin.com, procurement@harborfin.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence split question

Erin/James —

Following up after the internal sync. We reviewed options and propose Option A (server-side redaction) to keep the audit schedule intact. Action items we can commit to before Jan 6 auditor kickoff:
- Dec 22: S3 bucket exchange and IAM role grant (Harbor provides target bucket)
- Dec 29: 7-day dry run export (JSONL + checksum) and verification steps
- Jan 4: full 365 export handoff and manifest

Commercials: one-time engineering fee (Option A) = $14,500; 24-month term at the agreed seat tiers with a retention-export addendum (one-time fee covers staging/validation only). Also proposing a 10% credit if export exceeds estimated hours by >25%.

I've attached the final SLA draft and the retention matrix we discussed. Please confirm S3 details and whether you approve Option A.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood_sla_draft_v3.pdf; retention_matrix_proposal.xlsx; harbor_evidence_manifest_v1.csv
